decision: The pixel-estimated 閉じる click is NOT permissible as a grounded action: the control has no calibration entry and its exact hitbox is recorded as UNKNOWN, so an uncalibrated visual estimate stays unverified. If HELP_OVERLAY is observed, recover fail-closed: re-observe first, never repeat the identical click, and use the explicit, visually unambiguous affordance exactly as recorded (help-page back-arrow returned to the produce selection screen, verified by screenshot).
facts: Recorded incident canvas_misclick_001: a single click intended for the 閉じる (close) control of the produceReady info modal, estimated visually from a screenshot with no DOM/accessibility grounding and no calibration, produced the HELP_OVERLAY (ヘルプ: プロデュース W.I.N.G. topic list) at an unchanged /produceReady URL; the expected state was the produce selection screen.

The incident record states precision_claim 'none — exact hitbox UNKNOWN'; the recorded candidate causes are position mismatch, hitbox uncertainty, and state-transition timing (modal may have auto-dismissed exposing an underlying help affordance), with no variables isolated (n=1, no controlled experiment).

learned_constraints U1: the exact canvas click tolerance is UNKNOWN and was never measured — a calibration pass is required before any number is stated. U2: the time-lapse between observation and click is a plausible but unisolated contributing factor; the fresh-screenshot rule is a reasonable precaution, not an evidence-proven tolerance.

canvas_grounding_calibration_001 contains calibrations only for 次へ, キャンセル, the training-allocation + control, and 決定 — 閉じる is absent, so no calibrated hitbox exists for it; the calibration record is marked audit/benchmarking ONLY, NOT executable policy.

Recorded recovery for the HELP_OVERLAY state: the explicit back-arrow affordance of the help page was clicked, returning to the produce selection screen (PASS, verified by screenshot); one extra interaction, no observed state damage; the anomaly was reported and not silently retried.

learned_constraints F3 and R2: the URL did not change across the modal/help overlay pair, so URL identity is not state proof; the recorded practice is to never retry an identical failed click and to re-observe first.
inferences: A click positioned only by a pixel estimate on a control with no calibration and an UNKNOWN hitbox cannot be grounded; permissibility would require grounding evidence (calibration or DOM/accessibility identity) that the records do not provide for 閉じる.

On observing HELP_OVERLAY, the evidence-supported path is: fresh re-observation, classify the mismatch, then recover via the explicit unambiguous affordance as recorded; repeating the uncalibrated estimate is refused because the incident record and R2 forbid identical blind retries.
The recovery click itself needs the same fresh-observation discipline; the recorded back-arrow recovery succeeded once (n=1), which supports the practice without proving a general rule.
unknowns: The actual cause of the wrong-overlay outcome is UNKNOWN (classified WRONG_TARGET_OR_STALE_STATE, unresolved among three candidate causes).
The 閉じる hitbox position and tolerance are UNKNOWN; whether the modal auto-dismissed before the click landed is UNKNOWN (recorded hypothesis H2, UNVERIFIED).
Any live or current interactability is unknown from these offline records; nothing in them establishes present-day permission for any click.
reason: The 閉じる target has no calibration and its exact hitbox is recorded as UNKNOWN, so a pixel-estimated click on it is not a grounded, permissible action; positions derived from pre-action screenshots stay unverified until a calibration exists. On observing HELP_OVERLAY, the recorded fail-closed recovery applies: re-observe first, never repeat the identical click, and use the explicit unambiguous affordance (help back-arrow to the produce selection screen, verified once), treating the unchanged URL as non-proof of state.
